tier: TX (post hoc; BRSET labels exposed by the 2026-10-25 lock). Design site = BRSET Canon; aggregates only (PhysioNet DUA).
question: Why does E_768 refer healthy BRSET Canon CR eyes (frozen cut-off 1.092 on the expected-grade score)?

ruled_out.field_of_view_format: both cameras crop to the same aspect (1.22-1.25); within Canon the score correlates only weakly with aspect (r=0.28)
ruled_out.sensor_noise: fine-scale noise MAD 0.64 (Canon) vs 0.66 (Nikon); Ben-Graham signal SD 25 vs 27

batch_norm_statistics_AdaBN.design_eval: 1,000 Canon images (64 referable), adaptation on 512 patient-disjoint unlabelled Canon images
batch_norm_statistics_AdaBN.verdict: fails plan v6 rule 4a (spec >= 0.80 at sens >= 0.88): AdaBN closed

static_sensor_dust.verdict: Canon optics carry static dust specks, but removing them does not lower the scores

fine_detail.verdict: not driven by detail finer than 512 px

conclusion: A camera/centre appearance shift in coarse image features that none of the label-free corrections removes; per-site labelled calibration of the cut-off is the mitigation (TX evidence in site_calibration_brazil).
